title: 我的身体我做主
subtitle: 这是我的身体
character: wearing a yellow sweater, light blue trousers and white socks, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft oil pastel on warm kraft paper, rounded gentle shapes, warm peach, sky blue and lavender palette, cozy and reassuring
facts: 泳衣盖住的地方，别人不能看、不能碰
不舒服的触碰，可以大声拒绝
马上走开，告诉爸爸妈妈或老师
让我不舒服的秘密，要告诉爸爸妈妈

pages.zh:
这是我的身体。
我的手会画画，
我的脚会跑步，
我的嘴巴会唱歌。
我的身体，是我自己的。
pages.scene: The little boy stands proudly with his arms stretched wide in a sunny meadow, smiling, holding a crayon in one hand.

pages.zh:
我喜欢妈妈抱抱我，
喜欢爸爸把我举高高。
舒服的抱抱，
让我心里暖暖的。
pages.scene: In a cozy living room the father, a grown adult man, lifts the little boy high up in the air, both laughing, warm lamp light.

pages.zh:
可是有时候，我不想要。
奶奶想亲亲我，
我可以说：
「奶奶，我们击个掌吧！」
pages.scene: The little boy gives a cheerful high five to his smiling grandmother, a kind elderly woman with grey hair and glasses, in a cozy home.

pages.zh:
穿泳衣的时候，
被泳衣盖住的地方，
叫做「隐私部位」。
pages.scene: Top-down view of a striped beach towel spread on the sand. On the towel lie a pair of small blue swim trunks and a small one-piece swimsuit, both neatly folded flat, next to a little sun hat, a red pail and spade, and a colorful beach ball, the whole towel filling the picture.

pages.zh:
隐私部位是自己的。
别人不可以看，
也不可以碰。
pages.scene: A closed wooden bathroom door with a cute teddy bear sign hanging on the doorknob, soft warm light, a quiet calm hallway.

pages.zh:
只有生病的时候，
医生要检查身体，
爸爸妈妈会陪在旁边。
pages.scene: At a friendly doctor's office the little boy sits fully dressed on the examination bed while a smiling doctor listens to his chest with a stethoscope over his sweater, his mother beside him holding his hand.

pages.zh:
如果有人想碰我的隐私部位，
或者让我觉得不舒服，
我要大声说：
「不可以！」
pages.scene: The little boy stands firmly on his own with his feet apart and stretches one arm straight out in front of him toward the viewer, his palm flat and facing forward like a traffic police officer's stop sign, a brave serious face, a plain warm background.

pages.zh:
然后马上走开，
去找爸爸妈妈。
pages.scene: The little boy runs along a hallway toward his mother, who kneels down and opens her arms to catch him.

pages.zh:
不管是谁，
就算他说「这是我们的小秘密」，
我也要告诉爸爸妈妈。
让我不舒服的秘密，不用保守。
pages.scene: The little boy whispers into his mother's ear as they sit together on a sofa, the mother listening carefully, warm lamp light.

pages.zh:
妈妈抱着我说：
「你告诉我，你做得很对。」
我的身体，我做主！
pages.scene: The mother hugs the little boy on the sofa, both smiling, a warm cozy room with soft light.
